fields.description: Session User runs with the permissions of the person chatting. Service User runs as a dedicated, restricted account.
fields.label: Run As

fields.description: Other profiles a conversation with this agent may be switched to. Each one is still filtered by its own Allowed Roles, so listing a profile here offers it, it does not grant it.
fields.label: Alternate Model Profiles

fields.description: Roles allowed to use this agent. Empty means any user with the Agent User role.
fields.label: Allowed Roles

fields.description: Reusable rule sets this agent holds. Attaching a profile is what makes it grant anything.
fields.label: Access Profiles

fields.description: Rules for this agent alone, on top of its profiles. Effective access is always the user's own permissions narrowed by these rules.
fields.label: Access Rules

fields.description: Let this agent read attached files. Reading a file is not doctype-shaped, so it is a switch rather than a rule.
fields.label: May Read Files

fields.description: Tools from other apps. The generic tools are offered by the access rules above, not selected here.
fields.label: Tools

fields.description: Skills to load into this agent's instructions. Only Approved skills are used.
fields.label: Skills

fields.description: Offer this agent from a button on document forms.
fields.label: Show In Forms

fields.description: Forms that offer this agent. Empty means every doctype.
fields.label: Form Doctypes

fields.description: Tokens per day across all runs of this agent. Empty falls back to Agent Settings.
fields.label: Daily Token Budget
